commands.command: set -e; SERIAL=RFCT70L7E8J; STATE=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys telephony.registry | sed -n 's/.*mCallState=\([0-9][0-9]*\).*/\1/p' | head -n1 | tr -d '\r'); echo call_state=$STATE; test "$STATE" = "0"; echo bluetooth_on=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell settings get global bluetooth_on | tr -d '\r'); echo '=== bluetooth_manager help ==='; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell cmd bluetooth_manager help 2>&1 | head -80; echo route_prep_diagnosis=true
commands.output:
call_state=0
bluetooth_on=1
=== bluetooth_manager help ===
Bluetooth Manager Commands:
  help or -h
    Print this help text.
  enable
    Enable Bluetooth on this device.
  enableBle
    Call enableBle to activate ble only mode on this device.
  disable
    Disable Bluetooth on this device.
  disableBle
    revoke the call to enableBle. No-op if enableBle wasn't call before
  wait-for-state:<STATE>
    Wait until the adapter state is <STATE>. <STATE> can be one of STATE_OFF | STATE_ON
    Note: This command can timeout and failed
route_prep_diagnosis=true
